sources.content: # AGENTS.md for Spindrel. Spindrel is a command line linter for Dockerfiles. It is written in TypeScript and published to npm as `spindrel`. The minimum Node.js version is 20. Install with `npm ci`, build with `npm run build` (output goes to `dist/`), and test with `npm test`, which runs Jest. Lint rules live in `src/rules/`, one file per rule, and each rule ID uses the prefix SPD followed by three digits, such as SPD014.

When adding a rule. Register it in `src/rules/index.ts` and add a fixture pair under `test/fixtures/<rule-id>/`: `bad.Dockerfile` must trigger the rule and `good.Dockerfile` must not. Every rule needs a docs page at `docs/rules/<rule-id>.md`. New rules start at severity warning; raising one to error takes a minor release. Never renumber an existing rule ID, even after the rule is removed. Each fixture file must be a valid Dockerfile that builds. Rule messages are one sentence long and do not end with a period.

claims.text: New Spindrel rules start at severity error.
Each Spindrel rule needs a docs page under `docs/rules/`.
New Spindrel rules must be registered in `src/rules/index.ts`.
Spindrel rule IDs use the prefix SPD.
